expectFullname: C05-G01 sprite-actions 排序与默认目标 C05-G01-02 order=0 与缺省 order 不等价：显式 0 排在缺省之前，即使标签更靠后
patch:
--- a/packages/editor/src/core/sprite-actions.ts
+++ b/packages/editor/src/core/sprite-actions.ts
@@ -18,7 +18,7 @@
   return Object.entries(sprite?.poses ?? {})
     .sort(
       ([leftId, left], [rightId, right]) =>
-        (left.order ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) - (right.order ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) ||
+        (left.order ?? 0) - (right.order ?? 0) ||
         left.label.localeCompare(right.label) ||
         leftId.localeCompare(rightId),
     )
